import asyncio
from hyperbrowser import Hyperbrowser
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

class Worker:
    def __init__(self, account):
        self.account = account
        self.client = Hyperbrowser()
        self.session = None

    async def start(self):
        self.session = await asyncio.to_thread(self.client.sessions.create, {
            "timeout_minutes": 15,
            "profile": {"id": self.account.profile_id, "persist_changes": True},
        })

    async def run_job(self, url):
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            browser = await p.chromium.connect_over_cdp(self.session.ws_endpoint + "&keepAlive=true")
            context = browser.contexts[0]
            page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else await context.new_page()
            await page.goto(url)
            return await page.title()

    async def stop(self):
        await asyncio.to_thread(self.client.sessions.stop, self.session.id)

import os
from browserbase import Browserbase
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright


def read_title(url: str) -> str:
    client = Browserbase()
    session = client.sessions.create(project_id=os.environ["BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID"], api_timeout=120)
    try:
        with sync_playwright() as playwright:
            browser = playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp(session.connect_url)
            try:
                context = browser.contexts[0]
                page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else context.new_page()
                page.goto(url)
                return page.title()
            finally:
                browser.close()
    finally:
        client.sessions.update(session.id, status="REQUEST_RELEASE")
